scope: Local fresh browser contexts; 80 ms simulated delay per request, no bandwidth throttle. First-screen images decoded at ready; full roster prepared before play. Simulated missing image plus successful retry.

limitations: System font fallback depends on device; load a licensed font with loadCanvasFont for reproducible CJK coverage.
Rectangular hit testing, not per-pixel alpha. No scrolling/editable input/shaping parity guarantee with native.
